description: Defines data structures and constants related to RACH (Random Access Channel) configuration in 5G NR, including generic and cell-specific parameters, with focus on PRACH preamble settings, timing, and prioritization.

classes.name: rach_config_generic
classes.description: Holds parameters for generic RACH configuration, including PRACH index, response window, frequency start, and power settings.

classes.name: ra_prioritization
classes.description: Contains parameters for prioritizing random access procedures, including power ramp step and backoff scaling.

classes.name: ra_prioritization_slice_info
classes.description: Stores slice-specific RACH prioritization info, including a list of NSAG IDs and associated priority settings.

classes.name: rach_config_common
classes.description: Encapsulates cell-specific RACH configuration parameters, including generic config, preamble counts, timing, root sequence index, subcarrier spacing, and slice info.
